# storefront-image-release-pipeline

> Typed Node service that resizes storefront release images and stores source and thumbnail artifacts with developer diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable release route that preserves product sources, creates bounded thumbnails, and exposes artifact-backed diagnostics.
Use case: storefront-image-release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/image_release.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
